name: nuxeo-ui-e2e
$comment: This file exists for one reason: "type": "module". @a11y-scout/playwright and a11y-scout are both ESM-only ("type": "module" with an ESM-only ./dist/index.js), the repository root package.json declares no "type" and so defaults to CommonJS, and without this the a11y specs fail to load. It is NOT an npm workspace member -- the root declares no "workspaces" -- and it does NOT define the Nx project, which project.json does. One visible side effect worth knowing: Nx infers an extra `npm:private` tag on this project from the "private" field, alongside the scope:e2e and type:e2e tags that project.json declares.
